I have been farming this land for many years and I use the seeds I save from my own harvest—they grow well here and I know them. I cannot afford chemical fertilizer or pesticides for 6.37 hectares, and there is no water for irrigation, so I depend on the rains. My family will provide most of the labor, but I will hire some young workers during the busy weeding and harvesting times because this plot is large and I am not as strong as I used to be.
